description: This file contains benchmarking code for audio preprocessing effects (Automatic Gain Control, Acoustic Echo Canceler, Noise Suppressor, and AGC2) on Android, including effect creation, configuration, and processing, with detailed performance measurements.

methods.name: preProcCreateEffect
methods.description: Creates and configures an audio effect based on effect type and configuration.

methods.name: preProcSetConfigParam
methods.description: Sets a parameter for the audio effect.

methods.name: preProcGetShortVal
methods.description: Converts a float parameter value to a short integer.

methods.name: BM_PREPROCESSING
methods.description: Benchmark function that tests audio preprocessing effect processing performance.

methods.name: preprocessingArgs
methods.description: Sets up arguments for benchmarking with different channel masks and effect types.
